pages.title: An Unusual Supper
pages.text: Try one specific unusual food mechanic without a dish catalogue; bottles and chocolate support later preparation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Obtain the actual Nether item and read its effect before eating. One serving is enough; no catalogue of strange foods is required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Obtain and consume intestines as described by the installed advancement. The advancement text establishes a food interaction rather than an assumed crafting chain.
